_schema: Each entry: {date, name, phone(optional), result: connected|voicemail|no-answer|gatekeeper, mins(optional), outcome(one line), nextStep(one line), linkedTo(buyer/stock id optional)}
_workflow: Calum voice-notes after the block (or mid-block): 'call log: [name] - [what happened] - [next step]'. Max writes entries same session, links to CRM cards, creates follow-up tasks, updates streak + scoreboard. Daily totals feed the morning brief and Friday receipts.
